source.target: Figure 8 black-square plate-fin resistance markers only; no fitted correlations or Figure 7 derived coefficients

boundary_ownership.side_channel_floor: adiabatic duct surface outside sink width
boundary_ownership.fin_faces: conjugate conduction into both adjacent channels; outer fin sees a side channel
boundary_ownership.inlet_fluid: uniform normalized temperature0 at heated section
boundary_ownership.axial_solid_ends: axial solid conduction omitted; no physical inlet/outlet end condition is solved

equations.fluid: rho*cp*u(x,y)*dT/dz = k_air*(d2T/dx2+d2T/dy2); no axial fluid conduction or cross-flow
equations.fin: k_s*t*d2T_s/dy2 + q_left_to_fin_per_height + q_right_to_fin_per_height = 0 at each axial slice
equations.normalization: deficit theta=(Tbase-T)/(Tbase-Tin), so inlet fluid theta=1 and base theta=0
equations.discrete: M*dtheta_fluid/dz + K_ff*theta_fluid + K_fs*theta_solid = 0; K_sf*theta_fluid+K_ss*theta_solid=0, with symmetric conservative face conductances
equations.fluid_solid_face: G_per_axial_length=dy/(dx/(2*k_air)+t/(2*k_s)); uniform-through-thickness fin nodes with optional half-thickness resistance
equations.velocity_fd: solve -laplacian(w)=1, zero wall velocity, then normalize to equal per-channel mass flow

fixed_scenarios.material_interpretation: Independently declared representative aluminum conductivities; no claim to identify the tested alloy and no fitted k
fixed_scenarios.air_sensitivity: one-at-a-time k_air and rho*cp multipliers0.95 and1.05; illustrative perturbations, not measured bounds; viscosity only changes Reynolds flags at prescribed speed
fixed_scenarios.velocity_interpretation: Model-form sensitivity cases only; neither resolves10mm upstream duct or hydrodynamic entrance through fins; not confidence bounds
fixed_scenarios.primary_speed_mapping: Figure8 reported V assigned to arithmetic interior gap area; every channel has equal mass flow, side speed=V*g_interior/g_side
fixed_scenarios.speed_mapping_sensitivity: V multiplied by printed gap1.86mm/arithmetic gap1.849333mm to preserve inferred per-channel flow if author used printed area

applicability.cutoff_source: source numerical section3.1, printed p91; cutoff fixed before residual evaluation
applicability.boundary_flags: nominal and conservative author+graphical speed envelope reported; all12 recovered points retained
limitations: no base spreading or contact resistance
no experimental run inlet properties or tested alloy recovered
uniform side-channel mass flow is source reduction assumption, not measured split

precomparison_acceptance_gates.linear_scaling: normalized output invariant and dimensional Q scales with delta T
precomparison_acceptance_gates.mesh_policy: Choose only using analytic checks and numerical convergence on declared probe speeds; no experimental residuals read/computed until frozen choices saved

uncertainty_policy.graphical_readout: retain per-marker half-symbol widths/heights from extractor separately; never merge as a confidence interval
uncertainty_policy.target_status: loss-corrected whole-sink Rth, approximate graphic readout; not raw temperatures or aircraft validation
